title: Solar wind
description: Internal mission control for NOAA SWPC real-time solar wind (ADR 0007), GOES X-ray flux (issue #31), and Kp plus alerts (issue #32). Speed, density, and Bz use rows where active is true. The panel under Bz draws that same Bz with estimated Kp on a second axis. X-ray flux is the 0.1-0.8 nm channel on a log axis, with flare-class bands. Pipeline health reads ingest_log, not the measurement tables. Narrow window: each panel is one full-width row, so a phone-width browser stacks them. Grafana still draws its own menu and time picker, and these charts do not switch to a larger mobile axis. Below 640 px the page is tall, and that menu can crowd a 320 px window. This is the internal view; the public page is a later React app.

panels.title: Proton speed
panels.description: Solar-wind proton speed for the spacecraft SWPC marks active. Units are km/s. A typical slow wind is a few hundred km/s; a fast stream is roughly 500 km/s or more. The bucket is one minute because the feed is one-minute samples. A null minute is a gap, not a zero.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time_bucket('1 minute', time_tag) AS "time",
  avg(proton_speed) AS "km/s"
FROM solar_wind
WHERE $__timeFilter(time_tag)
  AND active
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Proton density
panels.description: Proton density for the active spacecraft, in protons per cubic centimeter. Dense slow wind is often several protons/cm3; fast wind is thinner. Same one-minute bucket and active-row filter as speed. If two spacecraft are marked active in the same minute, the point is their average.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time_bucket('1 minute', time_tag) AS "time",
  avg(proton_density) AS "protons/cm3"
FROM solar_wind
WHERE $__timeFilter(time_tag)
  AND active
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Bz (GSM)
panels.description: North-south magnetic field in GSM coordinates, nanotesla, active spacecraft only. Negative Bz is southward: that is the direction that lets solar-wind energy into Earth's magnetosphere. The line is red below zero and green at or above zero. Zero is the center of the axis.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time_bucket('1 minute', time_tag) AS "time",
  avg(bz_gsm) AS "nT"
FROM rtsw_mag_1m
WHERE $__timeFilter(time_tag)
  AND active
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Bz and Kp
panels.description: Sits under the Bz panel so the two traces share a glance. Left axis: the same active-spacecraft Bz, nanotesla. Right axis: estimated Kp, from 0 to 9. The orange line is the 1-minute estimated Kp. The purple step is NOAA's estimated 3-hour planetary Kp. Kp 5 is a minor storm on the NOAA scale; Kp 9 is the top of that scale. Southward (negative) Bz is a driver people watch before Kp rises. These Kp values are real-time estimates, not the definitive GFZ index and not a forecast. About: docs/about/kp-alerts.md.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time_bucket('1 minute', time_tag) AS "time",
  avg(bz_gsm) AS "Bz"
FROM rtsw_mag_1m
WHERE $__timeFilter(time_tag)
  AND active
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  time_bucket('1 minute', time_tag) AS "time",
  avg(estimated_kp) AS "estimated Kp"
FROM planetary_kp_1m
WHERE $__timeFilter(time_tag)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  time_tag AS "time",
  kp AS "3-hour Kp"
FROM planetary_kp_3h
WHERE $__timeFilter(time_tag)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: SWPC alerts
panels.description: Recent rows from swpc_alert, the real-time alerts.json feed. The message column is the first 180 characters. The full text stays in the table. This is SWPC's issued text, not a measurement and not a model. About: docs/about/kp-alerts.md.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  issue_datetime AS "issued",
  product_id AS "product",
  left(message, 180) AS "message"
FROM swpc_alert
WHERE $__timeFilter(issue_datetime)
ORDER BY issue_datetime DESC
LIMIT 8

panels.title: GOES X-ray flux
panels.description: Electron-corrected 0.1-0.8 nm flux from goes_xray_flux, watts per square metre, on a log10 axis. That long channel is the one NOAA uses for flare class. Bands: A from 1e-8, B from 1e-7, C from 1e-6, M from 1e-5, X from 1e-4. The short channel is stored and is not drawn. A zero or null flux is left out so the log axis stays defined. This is the measured flux, not an SWPC alert. About: docs/about/goes-xray.md.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time_bucket('1 minute', time_tag) AS "time",
  avg(flux) AS "W/m2"
FROM goes_xray_flux
WHERE $__timeFilter(time_tag)
  AND energy = '0.1-0.8nm'
  AND flux > 0
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Minutes since last good ingest
panels.description: Reads ingest_log only. A good run has error null: the file was loaded. Rows that failed validation increment rows_rejected and still leave error null, so they count as good. The number is the age of the oldest feed in ingest_log (wind, mag, xrays-6-hour, planetary_k_index_1m, noaa-planetary-k-index, and alerts). If any feed that has a log row has never succeeded, the panel says 'no good ingest' instead of hiding that feed behind the other one. The poll is every SWPC_POLL_MINUTES (5). Yellow means 15 minutes, red means 30.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE
    WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN NULL
    WHEN count(*) < (SELECT count(DISTINCT source) FROM ingest_log) THEN NULL
    ELSE EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - min(last_good))) / 60.0
  END AS "minutes"
FROM (
  SELECT max(finished_at) FILTER (WHERE error IS NULL) AS last_good
  FROM ingest_log
  GROUP BY source
) per_feed
WHERE last_good IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Narrow window
panels.description: Limitation for a phone-width browser, recorded here because this dashboard is internal Grafana (ADR 0012). The About page is docs/about/solar-wind.md.

options.content: Each chart is one full-width row, so a narrow window stacks speed, density, Bz, the Bz and Kp panel, alerts, X-ray flux, and the health stat instead of squeezing them side by side. Grafana keeps its own menu and time picker. These charts do not grow a simplified mobile axis. Below 640 px the page is tall, and the menu can crowd a 320 px window. This view was laid out on the 24-column grid; it is not a mobile-first page. About this page: [docs/about/solar-wind.md](https://github.com/howardisaacson/tachocline-industries/blob/main/docs/about/solar-wind.md). X-ray panel: [docs/about/goes-xray.md](https://github.com/howardisaacson/tachocline-industries/blob/main/docs/about/goes-xray.md). Kp and alerts: [docs/about/kp-alerts.md](https://github.com/howardisaacson/tachocline-industries/blob/main/docs/about/kp-alerts.md).
